notes.subject: מי פקד עליו
notes.rationale: Eliud's rhetorical question: 'who appointed HIM over the earth?' (i.e., over El) vs. 'who inspected the earth FOR himself' — kjv/jps read it as a charge over earth, ylt reads the earth as object

notes.subject: מי ... ומי
notes.rationale: parallel 'who... who...' rhetorical questions framing the two cola

notes.subject: תבל
notes.gloss rationale: rare word for inhabited world rendered 'lefatshe le nang le batho', its moist/inhabited nuance lost

translation: Ke mang ya mo beileng hodima ⟨את⟩ lefatshe? Kapa ke mang ya beileng ⟨sefathe⟩ sehlekehleke sehle? — ke mang ya beileng lefatshe lohle?
